"""Local structural/operational check. No evaluator answer key is present."""
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

assert len(sys.argv) == 3, "usage: python tools/check.py ARTIFACT MODE"
path, mode = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
assert mode in {"base", "payload", "routes", "timing", "mass", "image", "legacy", "external"}, "unknown check mode"
def bad_constant(value):
    raise ValueError("non-JSON numeric constant: " + value)
data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), parse_constant=bad_constant)
assert isinstance(data, dict)
assert set(data) == {"project", "status", "config", "history", "questions", "obligations", "evidence"}, "artifact schema"
assert isinstance(data["project"], str) and data["project"]
assert data["status"] in {"ready", "blocked"}, "draft is unfinished"
assert isinstance(data["config"], dict) and isinstance(data["history"], dict)
assert isinstance(data["questions"], list) and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in data["questions"])
assert isinstance(data["obligations"], dict)
assert all(v in {"fulfilled", "cancelled", "not_triggered", "blocked"} for v in data["obligations"].values())
assert isinstance(data["evidence"], list) and data["evidence"] and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in data["evidence"])
assert len(data["evidence"]) == len(set(data["evidence"])), "duplicate citations"
assert (data["status"] == "blocked") == bool(data["questions"]), "hold requires an explicit question"
def finite(value):
    if isinstance(value, float):
        assert math.isfinite(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for child in value.values(): finite(child)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value: finite(child)
finite(data)
if mode == "payload":
    assert isinstance(data["config"].get("items"), list), "payload requires item list"
    assert len(data["config"]["items"]) == len(set(data["config"]["items"])), "duplicate payload item"
if mode == "routes":
    stops = data["config"].get("stops")
    assert isinstance(stops, list) and len(stops) >= 2 and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in stops), "route shape"
    assert len(stops) == len(set(stops)), "repeated stop"
if mode == "timing":
    start, end = data["config"].get("start_minute"), data["config"].get("end_minute")
    assert isinstance(start, int) and isinstance(end, int) and 0 <= start < end <= 1440, "invalid daily interval"
if mode == "mass":
    assert isinstance(data["config"].get("mass_grams"), (int, float)), "mass is unresolved"
    assert data["config"]["mass_grams"] > 0
print("PASS " + mode + " " + path.as_posix())
